description: This file defines a configuration class for Stable Diffusion image generation models, along with methods to construct request URLs, map parameters, transform requests and responses for image generation workflows specific to the Fal AI platform.

classes.name: FalAIStableDiffusionConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for interacting with Fal AI's Stable Diffusion models, including URL generation, parameter mapping, and response transformation.

methods.name: str get_complete_url( self, api_base: Optional[str], api_key: Optional[str], model: str, optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, stream: Optional[bool] = None, )
methods.description: Constructs the full API URL based on the base URL, model name, and other parameters.

methods.name: List[OpenAIImageGenerationOptionalParams] get_supported_openai_params( self, model: str )
methods.description: Returns a list of supported OpenAI-style parameters for Stable Diffusion models.

methods.name: dict map_openai_params( self, non_default_params: dict, optional_params: dict, model: str, drop_params: bool, )
methods.description: Maps OpenAI parameters to Stable Diffusion-specific parameters with validation and transformation.

methods.name: Any _map_image_size(self, size: str)
methods.description: Maps OpenAI size strings to Stable Diffusion preset labels or custom size dictionaries.

methods.name: dict transform_image_generation_request( self, model: str, prompt: str, optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, headers: dict, )
methods.description: Prepares the request body for image generation, including prompt and optional parameters.

methods.name: ImageResponse transform_image_generation_response( self, model: str, raw_response: httpx.Response, model_response: ImageResponse, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, request_data: dict, optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, encoding: Any, api_key: Optional[str] = None, json_mode: Optional[bool] = None, )
methods.description: Processes the response from Stable Diffusion API, converting it into a consistent internal format, and capturing metadata.
